label: Main Room, The Spheres recording studio (Italy)
note: orchestral recording room with diffusors, wedge bass traps, an absorbent dropped ceiling and floating walls (paper); Neumann KH120 II loudspeaker (directional, facing the main microphones) at the first chair of each of 17 instrument sections (source), 22 session microphones (receiver): omni ambient pair and three omni mains, 17 cardioid section spots (in session 2 the Timpani and bass drum spots were wide cardioids; the paper does not say which session the RIRs come from)
